   487→    state: &BeaconState<E>,
   488→    body: BeaconBlockBodyRef<E, Payload>,
   489→) -> bool {
   490→    // For execution payloads in blocks (which may be headers) we must check defaultness against

   492→    body.execution_payload()

   501→    body: BeaconBlockBodyRef<E, Payload>,

   503→    is_merge_transition_block(state, body) || is_merge_transition_complete(state)
